audience: teams that collect e-signatures with SignRequest

useCases.title: Check who has not signed
useCases.text: List the signature requests and open one to see the status of each signer.

useCases.title: Find a document
useCases.text: Search the documents and read one document with its status.

useCases.title: Send a document for signature
useCases.text: Send a document or a template to the signers by email.

useCases.title: Remind signers who have not signed
useCases.text: Resend the signature request email to the signers who did not sign yet.

useCases.title: Cancel a request that is wrong
useCases.text: Cancel a signature request that went to the wrong person.
